title: Ignore binary build artifacts in test weakening semantic analysis
outOfScope: Changing test weakening signal thresholds, severity, or decision policy.
Treating undecodable binary bytes as source text or weakening analysis of valid UTF-8 test and workflow files.
Rewriting either immutable WI-03 predecessor archive.

sources.reason: Java Hosted evidence fails in git show output decoding after successful Gradle build.
Kotlin Hosted evidence reproduces the same 0xff UnicodeDecodeError.
C# Hosted evidence reproduces the same binary decode boundary.
_read_before requests Git blob bytes through text=True while _read_after already uses replacement decoding.
Existing behavioral fixtures cover text semantics but not committed binary artifacts with test-like paths.

riskAssessment.reason: The default Strict adopter route reaches a cross-language evidence guard that currently crashes on ordinary compiler output; correction must skip only non-text semantic content and preserve fail-closed Git/path behavior.

reasons: This recovery changes an installed AI evidence guard used by Strict quality.

executionDecision.reason: Three Hosted stacks reproduce one deterministic bytes-versus-text defect; bounded binary detection and skip semantics are testable locally.

preReviewWarnings: Confirm invalid Git revisions and unsafe paths remain fail closed.
Confirm valid UTF-8 test weakening signals remain unchanged.
Confirm binary files with test-like names produce no semantic signal or decode crash.
acceptance: Git blobs and worktree files are read as bytes before decoding, so invalid UTF-8 cannot escape as UnicodeDecodeError.
A changed binary artifact, including a test-like path, is excluded from text-semantic weakening signals and returns a continue decision when it is the only change.
Valid UTF-8 test, workflow, coverage, snapshot, invalid-base, and symlink behavior remains unchanged and fail closed where previously required.
English, Japanese, and Chinese guard references explicitly state the binary-content exclusion and its evidence limitation.
Focused tests, source-bound evidence, canonical Strict finish/archive, and replacement Hosted checks pass without modifying prior WI-03 archives.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: PR #545 replacement compatibility run 30658089369 passes the recovered router boundary but Java, Kotlin, and C# then crash in ai_check_test_weakening while decoding compiler-produced binary Git blobs as UTF-8 text.
constraints: Preserve all text signal and decision semantics.
Skip only content proven non-text before regex/diff analysis.
Keep Git revision validation and repository path safety fail closed.
Preserve both existing WI-03 archives byte-for-byte.
intent.rationale: The guard is a source-text semantic analyzer. Reading bytes first and declining semantic analysis for binary content prevents platform artifacts from crashing quality without pretending binary bytes contain reviewable assertions or workflow text.

rawUserRequest: Continue all Work Items through Hosted CI, merge, closure, and cleanup; recover deterministic binary diff failures without pausing for bounded implementation decisions.

declaredIntent.summary: Make Test Weakening Guard robust to binary compiler artifacts reached by Strict adopter quality.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A committed or changed binary artifact has a test-like filename and invalid UTF-8 bytes.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The guard does not decode-crash or emit text-semantic weakening signals.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a Git fixture containing invalid UTF-8 and NUL bytes at a test-like path, change it, and assert continue with no signals.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A valid UTF-8 test file loses assertions or gains a skip.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Existing warning/review signals and thresholds remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the complete focused test-weakening suite.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The base revision is invalid or a changed path escapes through a symlink.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The guard remains fail closed with an input error.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the existing invalid-base and symlink regression.
